issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台靠默认 150f 猜时长
UI 裁切段用 transform scale 放大到 1.6x/2x，特写字边靠合成层放大
2x 裁切按 origin 偏移取景，落在卡片之间，读不出放大的是哪块内容
字卡是死平 #0d0d0d 底 + Helvetica 回退字体的纯白字，像占位幻灯片
UI 段平底无暗角，与字卡之间没有统一的镜头质感
changes: 补 CARD_FOOTAGE_CADENCE_DURATION = 150；切点 14/22/34/42/52/62、字卡 5f 内 1.05→1 落定、收尾 62–105f 推 1→1.02 全部保留
UI 段 base 倍率改 CSS zoom 布局级放大 + 对焦点换算，段内推/移走 transform；1.6x 对准列表前三行，2x 对准 Active users 指标与曲线
首段推近改 ease-in（越推越快撞进第一张字卡）
字卡改冷调近黑径向底 + 暗角 + 颗粒，系统字体 184px 800 字重收紧字距、近白字；TODAY 下划线是全片唯一一笔强调色渐变
UI 段统一 0.16 暗角 + 4.5% 颗粒，收尾 105f 起颗粒冻结，尾段 45f 帧级真静止
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench fell back to a guessed 150f
UI crop segments scaled to 1.6x/2x with transform, leaving close-up text to compositor upscaling
The 2x crop was framed by an origin offset and landed between cards, so it was unclear what was being magnified
Title cards were dead-flat #0d0d0d with pure white Helvetica-fallback text, like placeholder slides
UI segments had flat grounds and no vignette, sharing no lens character with the title cards
changesEn: Added CARD_FOOTAGE_CADENCE_DURATION = 150; cut points 14/22/34/42/52/62, the 5f 1.05→1 card settle and the 62–105f 1→1.02 closing push are unchanged

UI base magnification now uses CSS zoom with focus mapping while in-shot push/pan stays on transform; the 1.6x crop frames the first three list rows and the 2x crop frames the Active users metric and curve
The opening push now eases in, accelerating into the first title card
Title cards use a cool near-black radial ground with vignette and grain, 184px/800 system type with tightened tracking in off-white; the TODAY underline is the only accent gradient in the piece
UI segments share a 0.16 vignette and 4.5% grain; grain freezes at 105f so the 45f tail is frame-still
